title: Get pinned tabs and homepage.
description: Get the authenticated user's pinned navigation tabs and configured homepage for the current team. The homepage is the page opened when the user clicks the PostHog logo or hits `/` — it can point at any PostHog destination (dashboard, insight, search, scene, etc.). Pass `@me` as the UUID.

methodDocumentation.text: Get the authenticated user's pinned sidebar tabs and configured homepage for the current team. Pass `@me` as the UUID.
